claim.quote: The observed limit rejects most of the low mass region of parameter space favored by the DAMA annual modulation signal.

name: Search for Low-Mass Dark Matter with CsI(Tl) Crystal Detectors
notes: The abstract gives 24,324.3 kg d; the 2012 paper on the same data set gives 24524.3 kg d (the difference is not adjudicated).

summary.plain: Re-analysing the 2009-2010 data in the 2-4 keV visible-energy window, KIMS looked for light WIMPs (up to 20 GeV) and found none; its limit rejects most of the low-mass parameter space favoured by the DAMA annual-modulation signal.
summary.technical: 24,324.3 kg d with a 2-4 keV visible-energy window; spin-independent WIMP-proton limits at 90% C.L. for WIMP masses <= 20 GeV/c^2; observed distribution consistent with null signals (Phys. Rev. D 90, 052006 (2014)).

title: Search for Low-Mass Dark Matter with CsI(Tl) Crystal Detectors
why_it_matters: A direct statement in the abstract about the region favoured by DAMA's modulation signal.
